comment: v3.3 measured tables: question-conditioned readout (opt-in gate), tie disclosure, readout silence, --evidence repro. Reproduce via tools/reasoning_probes.py --rebuild.
probe_fabric: model-reasoning-probe (14 QA-style lessons, data/reasoning_probe_lessons.jsonl; calibrate --energy-norm, T=1 adopted)

evidence_bug.root_cause: harness treated --evidence as value-taking and swallowed --model; on v3.2.0 the missing default model dir loaded as a SILENT empty fabric (lanes 0, vocabulary 0, calibrated false, all unknown_vocabulary) — reproduced exactly on a v3.2.0 worktree build with 'decide --evidence --state ... --questions ...' (no --model)
evidence_bug.fix_status: v3.2.1's loud load failure already cures it (exit 2 naming the dir); v3.3 adds a stderr hint when the failed dir is the default 'model' value

Test 1 who found the radio.note: gate fires on the question's NEW token 'who' and doubles the margin for the question-relevant answer

Test 4 unknown options xyz/abc/def.note: was answered by noise (abc 0.344 reported); all-dark readout now defers

Test 16 latest temperature.note: 14x confidence when the fabric has 'latest' lanes to the right value

Test 17 OOD submarine color.note: in a fabric that never saw the entities; the user's variant where the state lights the field (purple 0.472) remains an open mode — the state-salience override needs a deeper mechanism

gate ON (measured trade-off).note: 'which team' lanes mislead on this fabric => gate ships opt-in

tie_break_facts.mechanism: criteria iterate in std::map key order; max_element = first-max => alphabetically-first wins exact ties (user's 'Salma wins' = S < T, not last-position)
tie_break_facts.sem_hop: the v3.2 semantic readout term is itself a deterministic tie-breaker between differently-spelled labels (aaa/bbb lane sums equal 0.679428518, probabilities 0.500078 vs 0.499921)
tie_break_facts.disclosure: exact ties (p1-p2 <= 1e-9) now set tied:true in every reply path

old_repo_findings.whole_line_drive: si_main.cpp drives EVERY matched token of the turn into the field ('for (int id : matched) physics.drive(id, 3.0f, 6.0f, 20)') — ported as the readout gate, adapted to syfox's state/question contract (question tokens NEW vs the state only)
old_repo_findings.symbolic_edges: the old repo answers who-did-what via TYPED graph edges (Tariq -found-> radio); syfox's bag-of-words core has no typed edges — subject-object resolution (failure mode 5) stays an architectural limit
old_repo_findings.multi_hop: old repo derives multi-hop via rule composition on the graph; syfox's diffusion propagates energy through learned lanes (Test 10 answered lights), but 3+ hop composition remains weak
old_repo_findings.arithmetic: no arithmetic mechanism in either repo — architectural limit confirmed
